subject: Post-call: production-readiness compliance checklist — DPA, retention, pen-test ask
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.inference>
To: Sabrina Lopez <sabrina@stridebank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-02-15T16:10:00Z
Subject: Post-call: production-readiness compliance checklist — DPA, retention, pen-test ask

Hi Sabrina,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so your InfoSec & platform teams have a single place to reference.

Key pain points you raised
- Audit/logging: need immutable, tamper-evident audit logs for admin activity and model access with detailed timestamps.
- Retention: legal/regulatory requirement for customer transaction logs for up to 7 years — need options for long-term archival vs. hot storage.
- SOC 2 posture: evaluating our controls (especially logging/monitoring and change management) before procurement sign-off.
- Pen test evidence: you need prior pen-test reports and confirmation around scope and remediation cadence.

Goals from your side
- A technical acceptance checklist to hand to procurement & security by next week (target: 2028-02-22).
- A minimal set of artifacts we can share (SOC 2 Type II summary, audit log sample, DPA redline).
- Alignment on retention architecture (options + cost estimate) to include in the contract.

Agreed next steps (owners + tentative dates)
1) Ben (cc'ed) to send an artifact index and delivery plan — expected by 2028-02-16 (Ben).
2) Sabrina to share pen-test vendor contact & their expected report date so we can coordinate any on-demand scans (Sabrina).
3) Monica to prepare a short doc on retention options (archive TTLs, encryption, KMS integration) and cost delta — by 2028-02-20 (Monica).
4) Rohan to schedule a 30-minute joint call (security + platform) to walk through the artifact set — propose 2028-02-23.

Attachments: call-recording-20280215.mp3 (internal), will follow with artifact index CSV.

If any of these dates are tight, call it out and we'll adjust. Thanks — we want to make the procurement checklist as prescriptive as possible so it maps cleanly to your buying process.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0142

--
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference (hosted, dedicated, private)

From: Sabrina Lopez <sabrina@stridebank.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.inference>
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@stridebank.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-02-16T09:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: production-readiness compliance checklist — DPA, retention, pen-test ask

Rohan — thanks for the clear recap. Couple of clarifications and the pen-test timeline: 

1) Pen-test: our vendor (PenTestCo) is scheduled to run a windowed assessment for our cloud vendors in March; they can share a pre-engagement questionnaire this week. Vendor contact is Alex Ramos (pt-results@pentestco.com). We'll need Redwood to provide the scope (public endpoints, any non-standard ports) and a point of contact for scheduling.

2) Retention: legal requires that customer transaction logs be retained for 7 years in an immutable store; we would like options for cold archival (S3 Glacier/On-prem tape equivalent) vs. built-in retention with export.

3) SOC 2: we won't need the full report yet but a SOC 2 Type II cover letter + control matrix that maps logging/change management controls would be ideal.

I can make the procurement checklist if you can provide the artifact index and the retention cost delta. I am available for a technical session on 2/23 after 11:00 PT.

Attachment: stridebank-pen-test-summary.pdf (high-level vendor questionnaire summary)

Thanks,
Sabrina Lopez
Director, Cloud Security | StrideBank
sabrina@stridebank.com
+1 (212) 555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Sabrina Lopez <sabrina@stridebank.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.inference>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-02-16T18:40:00Z
Subject: Artifact index + minimal deliverables for procurement

Hi Sabrina — looping back with the artifact index we've used for other regulated bank customers. See the attachments and links below.

Summary of what we can provide (minimally)
- SOC 2 Type II: cover letter + control matrix (redacted where necessary)
- Audit log sample: sanitized event dump (JSON) showing admin actions, model invocations, and retention metadata
- Audit-log architecture diagram + TTL configuration options (hot 90d / warm 2yr / cold 7yr archive)
- DPA: template with our standard retention clauses and KMS/HSM integration notes
- Pen-test artifacts: summary of last vendor engagement and remediation timeline (we can coordinate with your vendor on scope)

Attachments: requested-artifact-index.csv (CSV: artifact, redaction notes, expected delivery window)
Related link: https://drive.redwoodinternal.com/Shared/StrideBank/ProdReadiness-ArtifactIndex

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP)
- 2028-02-16: Ben sends artifact index (today) — DONE
- 2028-02-20: Monica sends retention options + ballpark cost delta — Monica
- 2028-02-23: Joint technical session (security + platform) to review artifacts & retention architecture — Rohan schedules
- 2028-03-06: Formal procurement checklist submitted by StrideBank to Redwood (target)

If helpful, we can include a one-page mapping that ties each artifact to an acceptance criteria row for procurement (e.g., "audit-logs: immutable storage, SHA256 checksum, 99.999% durability").

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference
